name: Rope and plank (rotting hanging bridge)
description: Sagging catenary plank deck on rope rails with hanging verticals, tall anchor posts with raking back-legs at both ends; seeded missing, broken and hanging planks, uneven spacing and a slight sway. The sag is 8-12 % of the span; the anchors (and a ramp up to them) are raised as much as needed so the sag clears the ground and water, and the sag is clamped only as a last resort.
